flavour: The Elementalist channels the fury of a storm towards their foes, causing strong winds and icy rains to batter against them.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target enemy unit suffers a -1 modifier to its Movement and Initiative characteristics (to a minimum of 1). If this spell is cast, the effects of any other Hex previously cast on the target unit immediately expire.

flavour: With a simple gesture, the Elementalist summons a great, flaming sword with which to strike at their enemies.
effect: A single enemy unit the caster is engaged in combat with suffers D6+1 Strength 3 hits, each with an AP of -. These hits have the Flaming Attacks special rule.

flavour: As the Elementalist utters a curse, the armour of the enemy loses its lustre, corroding and crumbling from their bodies.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target enemy unit suffers a -2 modifier to its armour value. This spell may target an enemy unit engaged in combat.

flavour: The Elementalist summons forth a powerful spirit of earth, wind, water or fire to do their bidding.
effect: Remains in Play. Place a small (3”) blast template so that its central hole is within 15” of the caster. Whilst in play, the template is treated as difficult terrain over which no line of sight can be drawn. The template scatters D6” during every Start of Turn sub-phase (see page 95). Any enemy unit that moves through the template, or that the template moves over, suffers D3+3 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -1.

flavour: At the Elementalist’s summoning, mighty earthen ramparts rise up about their allies.
effect: Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target friendly unit gains a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and counts as being behind a defended low linear obstacle if charged. However, whilst this spell is in play the target unit cannot march or charge.

flavour: A mighty wind rips enemy warriors from their regiments, dashing them against the hard earth.
effect: The target enemy unit suffers D3+3 Strength 5 hits, each with an AP of -1. Once these hits have been resolved, the unit must Give Ground.

flavour: Tapping into the power of the Geomantic Web, the Elementalist opens a portal through which their allies can travel.
effect: If the target friendly unit is not fleeing and has not already moved during this Movement phase, you may immediately remove it from the battlefield and replace it anywhere completely within 12” of its original location, but not within 6” of any enemy models. The target friendly unit cannot move again during this Movement phase.
